trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list to finish the platinum. Keep a chapter-start save for the meditation requirement, then use the remaining entries as your cleanup checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Follow the story until Gone Fishing becomes available, then finish its objectives. Keep a manual save before starting a new chapter so you can revisit earlier opportunities without mission replay.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Work through the main missions in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Make a separate manual save at the start of the next chapter before continuing.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the missions that advance Chapter 2 to its conclusion. Before moving forward, check the meditation entry and retain your chapter-start save.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Continue the central storyline through the end of Chapter 3. Keep earlier chapter saves in separate slots rather than overwriting your only fallback.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the main story objectives in Chapter 4. Save manually when the following chapter starts so your recovery points remain easy to identify.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Follow the main story through its final mission and complete the concluding objectives. Preserve a separate save beforehand; the roadmap assumes no mission replay for recovering earlier opportunities.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Advance the story to Breakfast Run and complete the mission. Follow the on-screen objectives rather than looking for an extra trophy-specific condition, since none is stated.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Progress until The Cartel Heist is offered, then complete its objectives. Keep a manual save before the mission as part of your story route.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play through Child's Play when it appears in the story. The stated requirement is mission completion, so concentrate on reaching the successful ending.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Continue the campaign until you can start Headliners. Finish the mission and check the tracker before moving on to the next story objective.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Follow the main missions to VCIA Takedown and complete the operation. Keep your chapter-start saves separate from the current working save.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory as you advance through the story. No additional performance condition is given in the trophy description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the game's completion record to identify the tasks that count toward 100%. Finish the story first, clear smaller trophy objectives next, then work systematically through the remaining completion categories.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete stunts while exploring and keep a record of those the game accepts. Build toward 250 during your completion sweep; the description does not establish whether repeats count, so prioritize different stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Visit each activity type as it becomes available around Leonida. Keep a checklist by activity category and try unfamiliar map icons during cleanup.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the Shooting Range and work through every challenge until each displays gold. Repeat weaker results and focus on the scoring conditions shown for that particular event.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find the Top Fun Drone Race locations and win an event at each one. Record the locations you have finished so repeat visits do not obscure a missing venue.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win races with different event identities until you have twenty victories that meet the requirement. Track the event names, since repeated wins in one race do not satisfy the word different.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Seek out Cal's fishing challenge and review its scoring rules before starting. Beat his result using the fishing controls and equipment available to you.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find a playable arcade machine and take its game through to completion. Starting a round alone is insufficient; aim for the game's actual finish condition.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's mission strand whenever its next objective becomes available. Complete the final assignment; the exact location and unlock sequence are unconfirmed here.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Continue Kenton's assignments until you reach the final mission, then finish it. The precise starting location and prerequisites are unconfirmed, so check new contacts as the story advances.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand and complete its concluding assignment. Exact mission availability is unconfirmed here; return to the strand when further objectives appear.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Explore Leonida for stranger encounters and follow eight separate strands through their endings. Count finished strands rather than individual missions within one character's chain.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Take Randy's assignments through to the last mission and complete it. The exact encounter location and progression gates are unconfirmed here.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's mission chain until its final assignment is complete. The precise unlock route is unconfirmed, so watch for follow-up objectives while progressing elsewhere.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Treat this as the missable checkpoint and meditate at every available spot while advancing the story. Keep a manual save at each chapter start and check remaining spots before leaving that chapter, because there is no mission replay. Exact spot locations and availability windows are not confirmed here.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Find Bret's hunting objective and identify the unique animal he requests. Complete that hunt and any required hand-in rather than assuming an ordinary animal will count.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Check your card collection to see which cards belong to each set. Concentrate on finishing three complete sets and record the gaps before searching for more cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK interaction at distinct eligible locations while exploring. Keep track of completed places and continue until one hundred locations have registered.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Review the available challenges and choose objectives that overlap your current activities. Finish fifty challenges, checking completion records rather than counting partial progress.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Have your partner with you when the Wanted Level reaches four stars. Break pursuit together and remain out of sight until the heat is fully cleared.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan a route between three shops before beginning the robberies with your partner. Complete them consecutively while keeping the Wanted Level active throughout the sequence.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Seek out unfamiliar vehicles in different parts of Leonida as you travel. Check any discovery record the game provides and favor new vehicle types over repeated encounters with familiar ones.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Prepare Combat Focus before a fight with at least five reachable enemies. Activate it once and take down all five before that single activation ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The description points toward an unauthorized departure from VCIA, but the exact qualifying method is unconfirmed. Keep a separate save before experimenting at the airport and do not assume a particular aircraft or route is required.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The reference to Rhinos suggests a tank-related action, but the actual unlock method is unconfirmed. Save before testing relevant encounters and record any in-game clues rather than relying on a guessed requirement.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Approach a jewelry-store robbery with stealth as your priority and avoid detection through the attempt. The exact detection rules and qualifying store are unconfirmed here, so preserve a save before trying it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Carry out bank-vault robberies and escape successfully after each attempt. Keep a record of five completed robberies; the description does not confirm whether repeated vaults count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Locate an Armored Truck and complete its robbery interaction. Leave the area and successfully escape pursuit to finish the stated requirement.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Travel through the unexplored parts of Leonida during your collection and activity sweeps. Use the map to find remaining gaps, including outlying areas you would otherwise pass by.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Identify the gangs and complete an Illegal Operation robbery associated with each one. Track gang ownership so several robberies against the same group do not leave another group unfinished.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Look for a cocktail interaction with an Ocean Beach view. The exact venue and any time or character conditions are unconfirmed, so treat the description as a clue rather than a verified location guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The clue suggests driving out through a vehicle showroom, but the qualifying vehicle and location are unconfirmed. Make a separate save before attempting a destructive exit and follow any related in-game prompts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Investigate the bowling alley associated with Kolt & Associates for relevant interactions. The exact action behind follow-through is unconfirmed, so a normal bowling session cannot be promised to unlock it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description hints at a partnership but does not identify a verified task or location. Keep exploring partner-related interactions and preserve a save before testing a promising lead; the unlock method remains unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Watch for choices as you progress and keep separate chapter-start saves. The specific decision or sequence required is unconfirmed, so no particular choice is recommended as a guaranteed solution.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The clue suggests a second attempt or repeated event, but the relevant activity is unconfirmed. Record suspicious repeatable encounters as you explore rather than assuming any generic retry will count.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Investigate unusual encounters and clues you discover around Leonida. The trophy's trigger, location, and timing are unconfirmed, so keep a separate save before testing an unusual event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description calls for a melee drive-by, so look for the game's supported melee action while riding or driving. The exact target count, vehicle, and qualifying conditions are unconfirmed; do not assume the title alone proves a ten-target requirement.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bring Marked Bills to contacts who offer laundering and keep using that service as you earn more. Track the money earned through laundering toward $250,000 rather than treating all cash income as progress.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Build up funds and make purchases at shops during your normal progression. Track qualifying spending toward $100,000 and favor useful purchases while working on other objectives.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Locate the garage properties available for purchase and keep a checklist of those you own. Save enough money to buy the remaining garages during the completion phase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app to register eligible vehicles as you find them. Confirm each registration succeeds and continue until ten vehicles have been recorded.
